# Aperture

> Aperture is a two-founder AI automation and software studio based in India. It builds voice agents, AI automation, multi-agent systems, websites and apps. Typical timelines: automations two to three days, websites four to five days, multi-agent systems under a week, confirmed after scoping. Pricing is not published.

## Pages
- [Services](https://www.aperturecm.in/services): voice agents, AI automation, AI workflows, AI agents, multi-agent systems, chat and WhatsApp bots, websites, web and mobile apps, CRM and internal tools, integrations, dashboards.
- [Work](https://www.aperturecm.in/work): client projects across AI, finance, education, property, interiors and operations.
- [Studio](https://www.aperturecm.in/studio): the founders and how a project runs.
- [Contact](https://www.aperturecm.in/contact): WhatsApp, phone, email or a quick brief.
